The toolkit could not start

This usually means the file was opened straight from inside the ZIP, or the assets folder was moved away from this file.

  1. Extract (unzip) the whole download first. On Windows: right-click the ZIP and choose Extract All. On a Mac: double-click the ZIP.
  2. Open the extracted folder and double-click PDF Toolkit.html. Keep the assets folder next to it.

Alat tidak bisa berjalan. Ekstrak (unzip) dulu seluruh file unduhan, lalu buka PDF Toolkit.html dari folder hasil ekstrak. Folder assets harus tetap berada di sebelahnya.
